title: Coverage Policy: One Coverage-Billed PAP Therapy Equipment Device at a Time
content:
# One Coverage-Billed PAP Therapy Equipment Device at a Time

**Policy.** Coverage pays for one PAP Therapy Equipment device at a time. A coverage-billed order is not opened while another coverage-billed PAP Therapy Equipment record of the patient is on trial, in active rental or suspended, or is patient-owned with fewer than the class's reasonable useful lifetime in months elapsed since its setup date, unless the new order is the replacement opened under the replacement rules of PAP Therapy Equipment or a change of device class under which the earlier record is returned.

**Change of class during the trial.** A change from a CPAP class to a bilevel class during the trial does not start a new trial: the bilevel record's trial days continue from the CPAP record's setup date.

**Duplicate months.** Rental months billed for a duplicate device are denied with the denial reason "same or similar" and are never billed to the patient.

**Self-pay devices.** A self-pay device never counts as the coverage-billed device and never blocks one.

## Which classes this concerns

| Device class | Billed to coverage | Useful lifetime used for an owned earlier record |
|---|---|---|
| Travel CPAP System (E0601) | no — never the coverage-billed device | the class's reasonable useful lifetime |
| CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) | yes | the class's reasonable useful lifetime |
| Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) | yes | the class's reasonable useful lifetime |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) | yes | the class's reasonable useful lifetime |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) | yes | the class's reasonable useful lifetime |
| Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System (E0471) | yes | the class's reasonable useful lifetime |

## The earlier record, condition by condition

| Earlier coverage-billed record | A new coverage-billed order |
|---|---|
| on trial, in active rental or suspended | not opened, except as a replacement or a class change returning the earlier record |
| patient-owned, fewer months than the useful lifetime since setup | not opened, except as a replacement or a class change returning the earlier record |
| a self-pay record in any status | never blocks the order |

**Case (hypothetical dates).** A patient's CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) was set up on 3 March and is on trial; on trial day 40 the practitioner orders a Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) and the CPAP record is returned. The bilevel record does not start a new trial: its trial day count continues from 3 March, so the bilevel device starts at trial day 40 of the same trial.
